title: Mergers when price and quality are set by bargaining
title_zh: 价格与质量由谈判决定时的并购
authors: David J. Balan, Jeremy A. Sandford
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the effects of horizontal mergers on product quality in a bilateral bargaining environment. In our model, a competition‐reducing merger reduces equilibrium quality as long as the buyer's marginal rate of substitution of quality for price declines with price, holding quality constant. This condition is closely related to quality being a normal good. This result holds when price and quality are jointly negotiated, and it extends to a sequential setting in which sellers first choose quality and then bargain with buyers over price. We discuss applications to procurement and healthcare markets, as well as several extensions.
abstract_zh: 本文研究双边议价环境下横向并购对产品质量的影响。在我们的模型中，只要在质量不变的情况下，买方对质量与价格的边际替代率随价格下降而降低，那么减少竞争的并购就会降低均衡质量。这一条件与质量属于正常品密切相关。该结论在价格与质量联合谈判时成立，并可扩展至卖方先选择质量、再与买方就价格进行议价的序贯设定中。我们讨论了该结论在采购与医疗健康市场中的应用，并探讨了若干扩展情形。

title: Tax Compliance in the Rental Housing Market: Evidence from a Field Experiment

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study rental income tax compliance using novel third-party information and a large-scale randomized field experiment. The third-party information combines register data on the ownership and occupancy of apartments. The RCT used this new third-party information in the targeting and design of experimental treatments, and increased the propensity to report rental income and the amount of reported rental income net of expenses. Our research design also allows us to identify members of ownership networks and analyze spillover effects in tax enforcement between them. We find positive reporting spillovers. We do not find evidence of real effects on asset market transactions. (JEL C93, D83, H26, K34, R31)

title: Structural Change in Production Networks and Economic Growth
title_zh: 生产网络中的结构变化与经济增长
authors: Paul Gaggl, Aspen Gorry, Christian vom Lehn
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study structural change in production networks for intermediate inputs (inputoutput network) and new capital (investment network). For each network, we document that the share of output produced by services (relative to goods) is rising over time. While the relative prices of services that produce intermediates and consumption are rising, we find that the relative price of services that produce investment is falling over time. We then develop a multi-sector growth model to study these trends and their implications for economic growth. To match the relative price trends, inputs to intermediates production are complements and inputs to investment production are substitutes. Hence, structural change endogenously reallocates resources to the slowest growing intermediates producers and the fastest growing investment producers. Growth accounting exercises reveal that investment-specific technical change accounts for an increasing share of U.S. aggregate growth, with 20% of aggregate growth since 2000 due to investment structural change. Growth projections from our model show that structural change within investment networks alone can offset stagnating or declining growth in other sectors due to Baumol’s cost disease.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了中间投入品生产网络（投入产出网络）与资本品生产网络（投资网络）中的结构变迁。对于每个网络，我们观察到服务业产出（相对于商品）的份额随时间推移持续上升。尽管生产中间品和消费品的服务业相对价格在上升，但生产投资品的服务业相对价格却在下降。为此，我们构建了一个多部门增长模型来分析这些趋势及其对经济增长的影响。为匹配相对价格变化趋势，中间品生产投入呈现互补性，而投资品生产投入则呈现替代性。因此，结构变迁内生地将资源重新配置给增长最慢的中间品生产部门与增长最快的投资品生产部门。增长核算表明，投资专用型技术进步在美国总体增长中的贡献份额持续上升，其中2000年以来20%的总体增长源于投资结构变迁。模型增长预测显示，仅投资网络内部的结构变迁即可抵消鲍莫尔成本病导致的其他部门增长停滞或下降效应。

title: Industrial Concentration, Property Values, and Municipal Bond Spreads
title_zh: 产业集中度、房产价值与市政债券利差
authors: Kenneth R. Ahern
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper shows that the industrial composition of a city's local economy affects its municipal borrowing costs. In a panel of 1, 177 U.S. cities from 2005 to 2022, greater sectoral concentration magnifies default risk and raises bond spreads, especially for cities dominated by industries associated with low property values. Instrumental variables exploiting national sector-employment trends and regional house-price variation support a causal interpretation. A calibrated model of city default suggests that the observed spread effect understates the gross risk created by concentration, because higher concentration can generate agglomeration benefits that reduce spreads, especially for high-property-value cities.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，城市本地经济的产业结构会影响其市政借款成本。基于2005年至2022年间1,177个美国城市的面板数据，行业集中度越高，违约风险越大，债券利差越高，尤其是在以低房产价值行业为主导的城市中。利用全国行业就业趋势和区域房价变动的工具变量分析支持了因果解释。一个校准的城市违约模型表明，观测到的利差效应低估了集中度产生的总风险，因为更高的集中度可能带来集聚效益，从而降低利差，尤其是在高房产价值城市中。

title: Praying for Rain
title_zh: 祈雨
authors: José-Antonio Espín-Sánchez, Salvador Gil-Guirado, Nicholas Ryan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study rainmaking as an instrumental religious belief. We present a model in which a religious leader tries to persuade people to believe. Praying for rain can persuade only where the hazard of rainfall during a dry spell is increasing over time, so that prayer is most likely to succeed when people most want rain. We present evidence from prayers for rain in Murcia, Spain, where the hazard rate is increasing, that the church’s prayers for rain predict rainfall over two centuries. To generalize this finding, we gather an original data set of whether ethnic groups around the world traditionally prayed for rain. We find that ethnic groups facing an increasing rainfall hazard are 47% more likely to pray for rain, consistent with our model’s prediction that societies are more likely to pray for rain where prayer is persuasive.
abstract_zh: 我们研究求雨作为一种工具性宗教信仰。我们构建了一个模型，其中宗教领袖试图说服人们相信求雨的有效性。只有当干旱期内降雨风险随时间递增时，求雨祈祷才具有说服力——这意味着祈祷最可能在人们最渴望降雨时成功。我们以西班牙穆尔西亚地区的求雨祈祷为证据，该地区降雨风险率呈递增趋势，发现教堂的求雨祈祷在两个世纪中持续预测了实际降雨。为推广这一发现，我们收集了全球各民族是否传统上举行求雨祈祷的原始数据集。研究发现，面临递增降雨风险的民族举行求雨祈祷的可能性高出47%，这与模型预测一致：在祈祷更具说服力的社会中，人们更可能进行求雨祈祷。

title: China's Global Ownership
title_zh: 中国全球所有权
authors: Bai, Jennie, Laeven, Luc, Ke, Yaojun, Ru, Hong
official: 官方在线 2026-05-04 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the global footprint and real effects of Chinese overseas corporate ownership. By assembling a comprehensive micro-level dataset of 161, 773 firms across 159 countries (2012–2021), we independently reconstruct multi-layered ownership chains to trace capital through offshore tax havens to its ultimate origin. This approach reveals a global footprint substantially broader than official FDI statistics. Chinese-controlled foreign assets expanded at 20% annually, reaching $2.1 trillion or roughly 3% of global corporate assets by 2021. Chinese investors—particularly state-owned enterprises (SOEs)—strategically target R&D-intensive and supply-chain-linked firms. Following acquisition, target firms increase capital stock and R&D expenditures, yet these inputs fail to generate higher patent output and are accompanied by a significant decline in profitability. We document a novel 'innovation spillback' mechanism: while target innovation remains stagnant, Chinese parent firms experience a sharp acceleration in granted patents following their first developed-economy acquisition. Furthermore, a greater Chinese presence crowds out R&D at non-target peer firms, though aggregate industry-level innovation remains unchanged. China thus represents a distinctively state-driven model of global ownership that accepts weaker near-term performance to internalize technological capacity at home.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了中国海外企业所有权的全球足迹及其实际影响。通过整合涵盖159个国家161,773家企业的微观数据集（2012-2021年），我们独立重构了多层所有权链条，以追溯资本通过离岸避税天堂流向最终来源的路径。这一方法揭示的全球足迹远超官方FDI统计数据。中国控制的海外资产以每年20%的速度扩张，到2021年达到2.1万亿美元，约占全球企业资产的3%。中国投资者——尤其是国有企业——战略性地瞄准研发密集型和供应链关联企业。在收购后，目标企业增加了资本存量和研发支出，但这些投入未能带来更高的专利产出，同时伴随着盈利能力的显著下降。我们记录了一种新颖的“创新回流”机制：尽管目标企业的创新停滞不前，但中国母公司在首次收购发达经济体企业后，其授权专利数量急剧加速增长。此外，中国企业的更大存在挤出了非目标同行企业的研发活动，尽管行业层面的总体创新水平保持不变。因此，中国代表了一种独特的国家驱动型全球所有权模式，该模式接受较弱的短期绩效，以将技术能力内部化至国内。

title: The trade-off between costs and benefits: ESG performance and debt utilization efficiency
title_zh: 成本与收益的权衡：ESG表现与债务利用效率
authors: Qianhua Lei Wei Qiao Guilong Cai a School of Business Administration, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou, Chinab School of Business, Center for Accounting, Finance and Institutions 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Essentially, debt financing aims to enhance corporate performance through effective debt management, underscoring the trade-offs between associated costs and benefits. Using data from Chinese listed firms during 2010–2022, this study defines debt utilization efficiency using a DuPont analysis and demonstrates that in corporate settings, it is significantly improved by environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance. This conclusion remains unchanged after a battery of robustness tests. Mediation analysis shows that attention from external analysts partially mediates the relationship between ESG performance and debt utilization efficiency. We further find that intense industry competition positively moderates the relationship between ESG performance and debt utilization efficiency, while high environmental uncertainty negatively moderates this relationship. Our study thus expands the literature on debt financing and highlights the role of ESG in financial sustainability.
abstract_zh: 债务融资的本质在于通过有效的债务管理提升企业绩效，这凸显了相关成本与收益之间的权衡关系。本研究基于2010-2022年中国上市公司数据，运用杜邦分析法界定债务利用效率，并证明在企业情境下，环境、社会与治理（ESG）表现能显著提升该效率。经过一系列稳健性检验后，该结论依然成立。中介效应分析表明，外部分析师关注度在ESG表现与债务利用效率之间起部分中介作用。进一步研究发现，行业竞争强度正向调节ESG表现与债务利用效率的关系，而环境不确定性则负向调节该关系。本研究拓展了债务融资领域的文献，并凸显了ESG在财务可持续性中的重要作用。
